name: Tanqueray London Dry Gin
productionMethod: Column distillation with botanical maceration
description: Classic London Dry Gin with bold juniper character.
descriptionZh: 經典倫敦乾琴酒，具有強烈杜松子風味與複雜植物香氣。

name: Bacardi Superior White Rum
productionMethod: Continuous column distillation from molasses
description: Light white rum perfect for tropical cocktails.
descriptionZh: 清淡白蘭姆，熱帶調酒的經典首選，帶輕微香草甜韻。

name: Maker's Mark Bourbon
productionMethod: Pot still, wheat mash bill, new charred oak barrels
description: Approachable wheated bourbon with sweet vanilla character.
descriptionZh: 小麥波本，以濃郁香草與焦糖風味聞名，入門波本首選。

name: El Jimador Blanco Tequila
nameZh: 艾爾黑馬多白色龍舌蘭
productionMethod: 100% Blue Agave, autoclave cooked, column distilled
description: Clean and versatile blanco tequila for Margaritas.
descriptionZh: 清爽多用途白色龍舌蘭，瑪格麗特首選，帶鮮明龍舌蘭植物氣息。

name: Del Maguey Vida Mezcal
productionMethod: Espadín agave, pit-roasted, tahona crushed, open-air ferment
description: Artisanal mezcal with intense smoke and earthy complexity.
descriptionZh: 精釀梅斯卡爾，強烈煙燻氣息與大地複雜度，煙燻調酒的靈魂之選。

name: Fresh Lime Juice
description: Essential sour component. Always use fresh-squeezed.
descriptionZh: 最基礎的酸味來源，務必使用新鮮現榨。

name: Fresh Lemon Juice
description: Slightly less acidic than lime, with more floral notes.
descriptionZh: 比萊姆汁稍柔和，帶花香的酸味來源，適合更細緻的調酒。

name: Pineapple Juice
description: Tropical sweetness with gentle acidity. Great with rum and tequila.
descriptionZh: 熱帶甜香帶輕微酸度，與蘭姆、龍舌蘭搭配極佳。

name: Simple Syrup
description: 1:1 sugar to water. The foundation of cocktail sweetness.
descriptionZh: 1:1 糖水比例。調酒甜度的基礎，風味中性。

name: Agave Syrup
description: Nectar-like sweetness. Pairs perfectly with Tequila and Mezcal.
descriptionZh: 花蜜般甜韻，與龍舌蘭和梅斯卡爾天作之合。

name: Honey Syrup
description: 2:1 honey to water. Adds floral depth beyond simple syrup.
descriptionZh: 2:1 蜂蜜水比例，帶花香與焦糖深度，比糖漿更有層次。

name: Angostura Aromatic Bitters
productionMethod: Maceration of gentian and botanical blend
description: The universal bitters. Used by drops/dashes.
descriptionZh: 萬用苦精。以滴/dash 計量使用，提升調酒複雜度的神器。

name: Campari
productionMethod: Infusion of herbs and fruits in alcohol and water
description: Italy's iconic bitter liqueur. Essential for Negroni and Spritz.
descriptionZh: 義大利代表性苦味利口酒，Negroni 的靈魂，鮮紅色如同調酒界的印記。

name: Carpano Antica Formula Sweet Vermouth
productionMethod: Fortified wine with botanical infusion
description: Premium sweet vermouth with extraordinary richness and complexity.
descriptionZh: 頂級甜香艾酒，以極致豐富度和複雜香氣著稱，Manhattan 的最佳選擇。

name: Cointreau Triple Sec
productionMethod: Maceration of sweet and bitter orange peels
description: Premium orange liqueur. Essential for Margarita and Cosmopolitan.
descriptionZh: 頂級橙皮利口酒，瑪格麗特和柯夢波丹的關鍵材料。

name: Noilly Prat Dry Vermouth
description: Classic dry vermouth for Martini and light aperitifs.
descriptionZh: 經典乾香艾酒，馬丁尼的靈魂。帶草本清新，口感乾爽。

name: Fever-Tree Premium Indian Tonic Water
description: Premium tonic with natural quinine. The G&T gold standard.
descriptionZh: 天然奎寧頂級通寧水，琴湯尼的黃金標準。

name: Soda Water
description: Plain carbonated water. Extends highballs without adding flavor.
descriptionZh: 無糖碳酸水，High ball 的延展基底，不干擾風味。

name: Egg White
description: Creates silky foam in Sours. Dry shake first, then wet shake.
descriptionZh: 為酸酒系調酒創造絲滑泡沫層。先乾搖（Dry Shake），再加冰濕搖。

name: Fresh Mint Leaves
description: Essential for Mojito and Julep. Gently muddled, not bruised.
descriptionZh: 莫吉托與朱利普的靈魂。輕柔攪碎釋放香氣即可，避免破壞纖維。

name: Absolut Vodka
productionMethod: Continuous distillation from winter wheat
description: Exceptionally clean vodka. The blank canvas of cocktails.
descriptionZh: 極度純淨的伏特加，調酒的空白畫布，讓其他風味閃耀。

name: Myers's Original Dark Rum
productionMethod: Pot still distillation from molasses, aged in oak
aging: Blend of rums aged up to 4 years
description: Bold Jamaican dark rum packed with molasses and tropical depth.
descriptionZh: 濃烈牙買加黑蘭姆，充滿糖蜜與熱帶果味深度，Dark 'n' Stormy 的靈魂。

name: Johnnie Walker Black Label
nameZh: 約翰走路黑牌蘇格蘭威士忌
productionMethod: Blend of malt and grain whiskies, aged 12 years minimum
description: Rich blended Scotch with smoky depth and dried fruit complexity.
descriptionZh: 豐富的調和蘇格蘭威士忌，煙燻深度與乾果複雜度兼備，Penicillin 的經典基酒。

name: Aperol
productionMethod: Infusion of bitter orange, gentian, rhubarb, and botanicals
description: Italy's sunshine aperitif. Lower ABV sibling of Campari.
descriptionZh: 義大利的陽光開胃酒。Campari 的低酒精版親戚，Spritz 的靈魂。

name: Kahlúa Coffee Liqueur
productionMethod: Arabica coffee, sugarcane rum, vanilla, and caramel
description: The original coffee liqueur. Essential for Espresso Martini.
descriptionZh: 始祖咖啡利口酒，Espresso Martini 的核心材料，濃郁咖啡與焦糖甜韻。

name: St-Germain Elderflower Liqueur
nameZh: 聖日耳曼接骨木花利口酒
productionMethod: Maceration of hand-picked elderflower blossoms in eau-de-vie
description: Exquisitely floral French liqueur. 'Bartender's ketchup' of the 2010s.
descriptionZh: 極致花香法國利口酒，被譽為2010年代「調酒師的番茄醬」，百搭提升花香層次。

name: Fresh Grapefruit Juice
description: Tart and bitter citrus juice. Star of the Paloma.
descriptionZh: 酸苦兼具的柑橘果汁，Paloma 的主角，帶來層次分明的酸度。

name: Cranberry Juice
description: Tart berry juice. Gives Cosmopolitan its signature pink hue.
descriptionZh: 酸澀莓果汁，賦予柯夢波丹標誌性的粉紅色澤與莓果酸韻。

name: Fresh Orange Juice
description: Versatile citrus juice. Sunrise cocktails and tiki essentials.
descriptionZh: 萬用柑橘果汁，日出系調酒與Tiki的必備材料。

name: Grenadine Syrup
description: Pomegranate syrup. Adds ruby colour and fruity sweetness.
descriptionZh: 石榴糖漿，為調酒增添寶石般的紅色與果甜層次，經典Tiki的染色劑。

name: Peychaud's Bitters
productionMethod: Maceration of gentian root, anise, and botanical blend
description: New Orleans' signature bitters. Essential for the Sazerac.
descriptionZh: 紐奧良標誌性苦精，Sazerac 的靈魂材料，茴香花香主導。

name: Prosecco
productionMethod: Charmat method, Glera grapes
description: Italian sparkling wine. The fizzy heart of the Spritz.
descriptionZh: 義大利氣泡酒，Spritz 的氣泡心臟，帶清爽青蘋果與白桃風味。

name: Rittenhouse Straight Rye Whisky
nameZh: 瑞頓豪斯純裸麥威士忌
productionMethod: Pot still distillation, 51% rye mash bill, aged in new charred oak
description: Bottled-in-bond rye with bold spice. Manhattan essential.
descriptionZh: 瓶裝純裸麥威士忌，辛香料風味強烈，曼哈頓調酒的經典首選。

name: Hennessy VS Cognac
productionMethod: Double distillation in copper pot stills, aged in Limousin oak
description: Smooth VS Cognac with grape richness and vanilla warmth.
descriptionZh: 順滑的VS干邑白蘭地，葡萄豐韻與香草溫暖交織，Sidecar的靈魂基酒。

name: Jameson Irish Whiskey
productionMethod: Triple distilled blend of pot still and grain whiskey
aging: Minimum 4 years in seasoned oak casks
description: Triple-distilled Irish whiskey, exceptionally smooth and approachable.
descriptionZh: 三次蒸餾的愛爾蘭威士忌，口感極為滑順，蜂蜜與輕麥芽香氣，入門威士忌首選。

name: Suntory Toki Japanese Whisky
productionMethod: Blend of malt and grain whiskies from Yamazaki, Hakushu, and Chita distilleries
description: Delicate blended Japanese whisky designed for Highball perfection.
descriptionZh: 精緻調和日本威士忌，花香與青蘋果交織，專為完美Highball而生。

name: Appleton Estate 12 Year Rare Casks
nameZh: 雅伯頓莊園12年珍稀桶藏蘭姆酒
finish: Long, warm, spiced oak with lingering toffee
productionMethod: Copper pot still distillation from molasses, tropical aging
aging: Minimum 12 years in American oak barrels
description: Elegant aged Jamaican rum with deep tropical fruit and toffee complexity.
descriptionZh: 優雅的陳年牙買加蘭姆酒，深邃熱帶水果與太妃糖的層次交織，極致Tiki基酒。

name: Pernod Absinthe
finish: Long, numbing, lingering anise and herbs
productionMethod: Maceration and distillation of wormwood, anise, and fennel with botanicals
description: Traditional French absinthe with intense anise and herbal complexity. A rinse goes a long way.
descriptionZh: 傳統法國苦艾酒，濃烈茴香與草本複雜度，常作杯壁漂洗使用，少量即效果顯著。

name: Green Chartreuse
nameZh: 綠色夏特勒茲修道院利口酒
finish: Extremely long, herbal warmth, evolving complexity
productionMethod: Secret recipe of 130 herbs, plants, and flowers macerated and distilled by Carthusian monks
description: Legendary herbal liqueur made by monks from 130 herbs. Last Word essential.
descriptionZh: 傳奇修道院草本利口酒，由130種草本植物秘方製成，Last Word調酒的靈魂。

name: Luxardo Maraschino Liqueur
productionMethod: Distillation of Marasca cherries including pits, aged in Finnish ash wood
description: Benchmark cherry liqueur distilled from Marasca cherries. Aviation essential.
descriptionZh: 經典黑櫻桃利口酒，由馬拉斯加櫻桃蒸餾而成，Aviation調酒的關鍵材料。

name: Disaronno Amaretto
productionMethod: Infusion of apricot kernel oil with herbs and fruits in alcohol
description: Iconic Italian almond liqueur with rich marzipan character.
descriptionZh: 經典義大利杏仁利口酒，濃郁杏仁膏風味，Amaretto Sour的核心。

name: Tempus Fugit Crème de Cacao
productionMethod: Distillation and maceration of cacao nibs and vanilla beans
description: Premium crème de cacao with pure chocolate and vanilla character.
descriptionZh: 頂級可可利口酒，純正巧克力與香草風味，Brandy Alexander的經典元素。

name: Bénédictine DOM
productionMethod: Blend of 27 herbs and spices macerated and distilled, then blended with honey
description: Historic French herbal liqueur with honey and spice. B&B and Singapore Sling essential.
descriptionZh: 歷史悠久的法國草本利口酒，蜂蜜與辛香料交織，新加坡司令的關鍵成分。

name: Passion Fruit Purée
description: Intensely aromatic tropical purée. Pornstar Martini essential.
descriptionZh: 濃郁芳香的熱帶果泥，Pornstar Martini的靈魂材料，酸甜平衡極佳。

name: Coconut Cream
description: Rich coconut cream for Piña Colada and tropical drinks. Adds body and sweetness.
descriptionZh: 濃郁椰漿，Piña Colada的必備材料，為調酒增添飽滿口感與熱帶風情。

name: Fresh Ginger Root
description: Fresh ginger root for muddling or juicing. Adds pungent warmth to cocktails.
descriptionZh: 新鮮薑根，搗碎或榨汁使用，為調酒增添辛辣溫暖的層次。

name: Demerara Syrup
description: Rich syrup from unrefined demerara sugar. Adds depth to Old Fashioneds and tiki drinks.
descriptionZh: 未精製德梅拉拉糖製成的濃糖漿，為古典雞尾酒與Tiki調酒增添深邃甜度。

name: Orgeat Syrup
description: Almond and orange blossom syrup. Mai Tai essential and tiki cornerstone.
descriptionZh: 杏仁與橙花糖漿，Mai Tai的靈魂材料，Tiki調酒的基石。

name: John D. Taylor's Velvet Falernum
nameZh: 約翰泰勒絲絨法勒南糖漿
productionMethod: Rum-based infusion of lime, almond, clove, and ginger
description: Barbadian spiced syrup with lime, almond, and clove. Tiki cocktail essential.
descriptionZh: 巴貝多辛香料糖漿，融合萊姆、杏仁與丁香，Tiki調酒的關鍵調味。

name: Regans' Orange Bitters No. 6
productionMethod: Maceration and distillation of orange peel, cardamom, caraway, and botanicals
description: Classic orange bitters with cardamom and caraway. Martini and Old Fashioned enhancer.
descriptionZh: 經典橙皮苦精，帶小荳蔻與葛縷子香氣，馬丁尼與古典雞尾酒的提味利器。

name: Fever-Tree Premium Ginger Beer
description: Premium ginger beer with natural ginger heat. Moscow Mule and Dark 'n' Stormy essential.
descriptionZh: 頂級薑汁啤酒，天然薑辣風味，莫斯科騾子與暗風暴的必備混合材料。

name: Club Soda
description: Carbonated water with added minerals. Adds fizz and slight mineral edge to highballs.
descriptionZh: 添加礦物鹽的碳酸水，為高球杯調酒增添氣泡感與淡淡礦物質口感。

name: Hendrick's Gin
productionMethod: Carter-Head still and pot still blend with cucumber and rose infusion
description: Scottish gin renowned for its distinctive cucumber and rose character, a modern classic.
descriptionZh: 蘇格蘭琴酒，以獨特的小黃瓜與玫瑰風味聞名，現代經典之作。

name: Roku Japanese Gin
finish: Elegant, clean, lingering sakura and yuzu
productionMethod: Multiple distillation with six Japanese botanicals including sakura, yuzu, and sencha
description: Suntory's Japanese craft gin featuring six unique Japanese botanicals for a delicate, balanced spirit.
descriptionZh: 三得利日本琴酒，以六種日本植物素材打造，風味細膩平衡，帶櫻花與柚子芬芳。

name: Plantation 3 Stars White Rum
productionMethod: Blend of pot and column still rums from three Caribbean islands, briefly aged and charcoal filtered
description: Artful blend of Caribbean white rums with surprising depth for a white spirit. Excellent in Daiquiris.
descriptionZh: 精心調配的加勒比海白蘭姆酒，風味深度超越一般白蘭姆，是Daiquiri的絕佳選擇。

name: Appleton Estate 12 Year Rare Casks Jamaican Rum
nameZh: 雅伯頓莊園12年牙買加蘭姆酒
finish: Long, warm, complex with lingering Jamaican funk
productionMethod: Pot and column still blend, minimum 12 years aged in oak barrels
description: Premium 12-year Jamaican rum with distinctive funky character, rich toffee, and tropical depth.
descriptionZh: 優質12年牙買加蘭姆酒，獨特的牙買加風味（hogo），太妃糖與熱帶水果交織。

name: Havana Club Añejo 7 Años
nameZh: 哈瓦那俱樂部7年陳釀蘭姆酒
finish: Medium-long, warm, smooth with tobacco and cocoa notes
productionMethod: Column distilled, aged minimum 7 years in tropical climate, master blended
description: Cuba's iconic 7-year aged rum with rich caramel, vanilla, and tobacco notes. A sipping rum that shines in cocktails.
descriptionZh: 古巴標誌性7年陳釀蘭姆酒，焦糖、香草與菸草風味豐富，純飲或調酒皆宜。

name: Patrón Silver Tequila
productionMethod: Tahona and roller mill crushed, pot and column distilled from 100% Weber Blue agave
description: Premium blanco tequila with smooth agave character and clean citrus-pepper finish. Versatile in Margaritas.
descriptionZh: 頂級銀色龍舌蘭，順滑龍舌蘭風味，柑橘與白胡椒收尾，Margarita的優質之選。

name: Casamigos Reposado Tequila
nameZh: 卡薩米戈斯金色龍舌蘭
finish: Smooth, warm, lingering caramel and agave
productionMethod: Slow roasted 100% Blue Weber agave, rested 7 months in American oak
description: Ultra-smooth reposado tequila rested for 7 months, with caramel and vanilla oak character.
descriptionZh: 極度順滑的金色龍舌蘭，陳放七個月，焦糖與香草橡木風味優雅。

name: Wild Turkey 101 Bourbon
finish: Long, spicy, warming with lingering caramel and char
productionMethod: High rye mashbill (75/13/12), aged 6-8 years in #4 char American oak
aging: 6-8 years in new charred American oak
description: High-proof bourbon with bold flavor that stands up in any cocktail. A bartender's go-to for Old Fashioneds.
descriptionZh: 高酒精度波本威士忌，風味大膽強勁，任何調酒都壓不住，調酒師做Old Fashioned的首選。

name: Woodford Reserve Bourbon
finish: Long, smooth, creamy vanilla and cocoa
productionMethod: Triple pot distilled, proprietary yeast, aged in heavily toasted and lightly charred barrels
aging: 6-7 years in new charred American oak
description: Premium Kentucky bourbon with exceptional smoothness, rich vanilla, and dried fruit complexity.
descriptionZh: 頂級肯塔基波本威士忌，極致順滑，香草豐富與乾果複雜度兼備。

name: Bulleit Rye Whiskey
finish: Long, dry, peppery with lingering rye spice
productionMethod: 95% rye mashbill, aged 4-7 years in new charred American oak
aging: 4-7 years in new charred American oak
description: High-rye whiskey with assertive spice and pepper. Perfect for Manhattan and Sazerac cocktails.
descriptionZh: 高裸麥威士忌，辛香與胡椒風味強勢，Manhattan和Sazerac的完美選擇。

name: Jameson Irish Whiskey
productionMethod: Triple distilled blend of pot still and grain whiskey, aged in seasoned oak
aging: Minimum 4 years in bourbon and sherry casks
description: Ireland's most popular whiskey, triple distilled for exceptional smoothness. Great in Irish Coffee.
descriptionZh: 愛爾蘭最受歡迎的威士忌，三次蒸餾帶來極致順滑口感，愛爾蘭咖啡的首選。

name: Nikka Coffey Grain Whisky
nameZh: 余市咖啡式穀物威士忌
finish: Long, sweet, creamy with tropical fade
productionMethod: Coffey (continuous) still distillation of corn and malted barley, aged in American oak
description: Uniquely sweet and creamy Japanese grain whisky from Nikka's Coffey still, with bourbon-like richness.
descriptionZh: 獨特的日本穀物威士忌，使用咖啡式蒸餾器製成，甜美滑順，帶波本般的豐富度。

name: Hakushu 12 Year Single Malt
nameZh: 白州12年單一麥芽威士忌
finish: Medium, crisp, minty with subtle smoke
productionMethod: Pot still distillation with lightly peated and unpeated malt, aged in American and Japanese oak
description: Forest-like Japanese single malt with herbal freshness, gentle smoke, and remarkable crispness. Highly sought after.
descriptionZh: 如同森林般的日本單一麥芽威士忌，草本清新與輕柔煙燻交織，清脆非凡，稀有珍品。

name: Grey Goose Vodka
productionMethod: Single distillation from soft winter wheat, filtered through Champagne limestone
description: Premium French wheat vodka known for its exceptional smoothness and subtle elegance.
descriptionZh: 頂級法國小麥伏特加，以卓越順滑度與微妙優雅著稱。

name: Belvedere Vodka
productionMethod: Quadruple distilled from Dankowskie Gold rye, using artesian well water
description: Polish rye vodka with distinctive creamy texture and subtle spice character.
descriptionZh: 波蘭裸麥伏特加，獨特的奶油質地與微妙香料風味。

name: Rémy Martin VSOP Cognac
finish: Long, elegant, fruity with lingering vanilla and spice
productionMethod: Double distilled in copper pot stills, exclusively Fine Champagne blend (Grande and Petite Champagne)
description: Exclusively Fine Champagne cognac with rich stone fruit, vanilla, and elegant oak. A step above VS.
descriptionZh: 純正優質香檳區干邑，豐富核果、香草與優雅橡木，比VS更上一層的品質。

name: Pernod Absinthe
finish: Long, numbing, lingering anise and herbs
productionMethod: Maceration and distillation of wormwood, anise, and fennel with botanicals
description: Classic French absinthe with intense anise and herbal complexity. Used as a rinse in many classic cocktails.
descriptionZh: 經典法國苦艾酒，濃烈茴香與草本複雜度，常用於經典調酒的杯壁漂洗。

name: Leblon Cachaça
productionMethod: Single distillation of fresh sugarcane juice in copper alembic stills, briefly rested in XO cognac casks
description: Premium Brazilian cachaça with clean sugarcane character. Essential for the Caipirinha.
descriptionZh: 頂級巴西卡夏莎，純淨甘蔗風味，Caipirinha的靈魂之酒。

name: Baileys Irish Cream
productionMethod: Blend of Irish whiskey, fresh dairy cream, cocoa, and vanilla extracts
description: The original Irish cream liqueur blending whiskey, cream, chocolate, and vanilla. A dessert in a glass.
descriptionZh: 原創愛爾蘭奶油利口酒，威士忌、鮮奶油、巧克力與香草的完美融合，杯中甜點。

name: Frangelico
nameZh: 富蘭杰利可榛果利口酒
productionMethod: Infusion of toasted hazelnuts, cocoa, vanilla, and other natural flavors in spirit
description: Italian hazelnut liqueur with rich nutty flavor and hints of cocoa and vanilla.
descriptionZh: 義大利榛果利口酒，濃郁堅果風味伴隨可可與香草的微妙層次。

name: Chambord
nameZh: 香波堡黑覆盆子利口酒
productionMethod: Infusion of black raspberries, blackberries, Madagascar vanilla, Moroccan citrus peel, honey, and cognac
description: Royal French black raspberry liqueur with luxurious berry richness and cognac depth.
descriptionZh: 法國皇家黑覆盆子利口酒，奢華莓果豐韻與干邑深度。

name: Midori Melon Liqueur
productionMethod: Neutral spirit infused with premium Yubari and muskmelon flavors
description: Iconic bright green melon liqueur. Brings vivid color and sweet melon flavor to cocktails.
descriptionZh: 標誌性亮綠色蜜瓜利口酒，為調酒帶來鮮豔色彩與甜蜜哈密瓜風味。

name: Galliano L'Autentico
productionMethod: Infusion and distillation of over 30 herbs, spices, and plant extracts
description: Italian herbal liqueur with prominent vanilla and anise character. Key ingredient in the Harvey Wallbanger.
descriptionZh: 義大利草本利口酒，以突出的香草與茴香風味著稱，Harvey Wallbanger的關鍵材料。

name: Drambuie
nameZh: 杜林標蜂蜜威士忌利口酒
finish: Long, honeyed, warming with herbal fade
productionMethod: Blend of aged Scotch whisky, heather honey, herbs, and spices based on a secret recipe
description: Scotch-based honey liqueur with a secret herbal recipe. The soul of the Rusty Nail cocktail.
descriptionZh: 以蘇格蘭威士忌為基底的蜂蜜利口酒，秘密草本配方，Rusty Nail調酒的靈魂。

name: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge
nameZh: 柑曼怡橙味干邑利口酒
productionMethod: Distillation of bitter orange peel blended with cognac and aged in French oak
description: Prestigious orange-cognac liqueur with depth beyond simple triple sec. Elevates Margaritas and Sidecars.
descriptionZh: 尊貴的橙味干邑利口酒，深度遠超一般橙酒，提升Margarita和Sidecar的品質。

name: Amaro Montenegro
finish: Medium, bittersweet, elegant orange and herb fade
productionMethod: Infusion of 40 botanicals including herbs, spices, and citrus in spirit
description: One of Italy's most beloved amari, with a perfectly balanced bitter-sweet profile and floral elegance.
descriptionZh: 義大利最受歡迎的苦酒之一，苦甜完美平衡，帶花香優雅。

name: Fernet-Branca
productionMethod: Secret recipe of 27 herbs and spices macerated in grape spirit, aged in oak for minimum one year
description: Intensely bitter Italian amaro with menthol and herbal character. A bartender handshake and Argentine obsession.
descriptionZh: 極度苦澀的義大利苦酒，薄荷醇與草本風味，調酒師暗號與阿根廷國民飲品。

name: Cynar
productionMethod: Infusion of 13 herbs and plants including artichoke in spirit
description: Unique artichoke-based Italian amaro with earthy, bittersweet depth. Surprisingly versatile in cocktails.
descriptionZh: 以朝鮮薊為基底的獨特義大利苦酒，泥土般的苦甜深度，在調酒中出奇地百搭。

name: Licor 43
productionMethod: Maceration and distillation of 43 different ingredients including citrus, vanilla, and Mediterranean herbs
description: Spanish vanilla-citrus liqueur made from 43 ingredients. Sweet, versatile, and crowd-pleasing.
descriptionZh: 西班牙香草柑橘利口酒，由43種原料製成，甜美百搭，深受大眾喜愛。

name: Crème de Violette
productionMethod: Maceration of violet flowers and petals in neutral spirit with sugar
description: Delicate violet-flavored liqueur that gives the Aviation cocktail its signature purple hue.
descriptionZh: 精緻的紫羅蘭利口酒，賦予Aviation調酒標誌性的紫色光澤。

name: Champagne (Moët & Chandon Impérial)
productionMethod: Traditional méthode champenoise, Pinot Noir/Chardonnay/Pinot Meunier blend
description: Iconic French champagne with fine bubbles, toasty brioche, and crisp apple character. Essential for celebrations and cocktails.
descriptionZh: 經典法國香檳，細膩氣泡，烤麵包布里歐與清脆蘋果風味，慶典與調酒的首選。

name: Cabernet Sauvignon (Napa Valley)
finish: Long, structured, tannic with dark fruit and oak
productionMethod: Fermented in stainless steel or oak, aged 18-24 months in French and American oak barrels
description: Full-bodied Napa Cabernet with bold dark fruit, firm tannins, and oak complexity.
descriptionZh: 飽滿的納帕谷赤霞珠，大膽黑色水果、堅實單寧與橡木複雜度。

name: Pinot Noir (Burgundy)
finish: Medium-long, silky, earthy with lingering red fruit
productionMethod: Whole cluster and destemmed fermentation, aged 12-18 months in French oak
description: Elegant Burgundy Pinot Noir with red berry fruit, earthy complexity, and silky texture.
descriptionZh: 優雅的勃艮第黑皮諾，紅莓果、泥土複雜度與絲滑質地。

name: Merlot (Bordeaux)
finish: Medium, smooth, plummy with gentle oak
productionMethod: Traditional Bordeaux winemaking, aged 12-18 months in French oak barriques
description: Medium-bodied Bordeaux Merlot with plush plum, soft tannins, and elegant oak integration.
descriptionZh: 中等酒體的波爾多梅洛，豐滿李子、柔和單寧與優雅橡木融合。

name: Sauvignon Blanc (Marlborough)
productionMethod: Cool-climate fermentation in stainless steel, minimal oak contact
description: Vibrant Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc with intense tropical fruit, grassy notes, and crisp acidity.
descriptionZh: 活力四射的馬爾堡長相思，濃郁熱帶水果、青草香氣與爽脆酸度。

name: Chardonnay (Burgundy)
finish: Long, creamy, mineral with citrus and oak
productionMethod: Barrel fermented and aged in French oak with bâtonnage (lees stirring)
description: Classic Burgundy Chardonnay with creamy texture, stone fruit, and elegant mineral backbone.
descriptionZh: 經典勃艮第夏多內，奶油質地、核果與優雅礦物骨架。

name: Riesling (Mosel)
finish: Long, electric acidity, mineral with lingering fruit
productionMethod: Cool-climate fermentation in stainless steel, steep slate vineyard terroir
description: Aromatic Mosel Riesling with electric acidity, stone fruit, and distinctive slate minerality.
descriptionZh: 芳香四溢的摩澤爾雷司令，電光般酸度，核果與獨特板岩礦物感。

name: Malbec (Mendoza)
finish: Medium-long, velvety, dark fruit with chocolate
productionMethod: High-altitude viticulture, aged 12-16 months in French and American oak
description: Full-bodied Argentinian Malbec with velvety dark fruit, chocolate, and violet notes from high-altitude vineyards.
descriptionZh: 飽滿的阿根廷馬爾貝克，絲絨般黑色水果、巧克力與紫羅蘭，來自高海拔葡萄園。

name: Tempranillo (Rioja Reserva)
finish: Long, savoury, leather and tobacco with oak warmth
productionMethod: Traditional Rioja winemaking, aged minimum 12 months in American and French oak, 12 months in bottle
aging: 12 months in oak, 12 months in bottle
description: Classic Rioja Reserva with leather, tobacco, and vanilla oak character from extended aging.
descriptionZh: 經典里奧哈珍藏，皮革、菸草與香草橡木特色，來自長時間陳年。

name: Pinot Grigio (Alto Adige)
productionMethod: Cool-climate mountain viticulture, gentle pressing, stainless steel fermentation
description: Crisp Italian Pinot Grigio from the alpine Alto Adige region with mineral purity and delicate fruit.
descriptionZh: 來自阿爾卑斯山腳上阿迪傑地區的清爽灰皮諾，礦物純淨與細膩果味。

name: Rosé (Provence)
finish: Crisp, dry, refreshing with delicate fruit
productionMethod: Direct press method, blend of Grenache, Cinsault, and Mourvèdre, stainless steel fermentation
description: Classic dry Provence rosé with pale salmon color, delicate strawberry, and Mediterranean herbal character.
descriptionZh: 經典普羅旺斯粉紅酒，淡鮭魚色，細膩草莓與地中海草本風味。

name: Barolo (Piedmont)
finish: Very long, tannic, tar and roses
productionMethod: 100% Nebbiolo, traditional long maceration, aged minimum 38 months including 18 in oak
description: Italy's 'King of Wines' from Nebbiolo. Powerful tannins, tar, roses, and truffle with extraordinary aging potential.
descriptionZh: 義大利「葡萄酒之王」，內比歐露品種，強勁單寧，焦油、玫瑰與松露，陳年潛力非凡。

name: Chianti Classico
finish: Medium-long, savoury, cherry-herbal with pleasant grip
productionMethod: Primarily Sangiovese, aged minimum 12 months including time in oak
description: Tuscan Sangiovese with bright cherry, savory herbs, and food-friendly acidity. The wine of Florence.
descriptionZh: 托斯卡尼桑嬌維塞，明亮櫻桃、鹹香草本與親食性酸度，佛羅倫斯之酒。

name: Gewürztraminer (Alsace)
finish: Long, aromatic, ginger-rose with slight bitterness
productionMethod: Late harvest or dry, fermented in stainless steel or large oak, aromatic grape variety
description: Intensely aromatic Alsatian white with lychee, rose, and exotic spice. Unmistakably perfumed.
descriptionZh: 濃郁芳香的阿爾薩斯白酒，荔枝、玫瑰與異國香料，香水般的獨特風味。

name: Sauternes
finish: Very long, honeyed, complex with persistent sweetness
productionMethod: Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc affected by noble rot (Botrytis cinerea), aged 18-24 months in French oak
description: Luxurious French dessert wine from botrytis-affected grapes with intense honey, apricot, and saffron complexity.
descriptionZh: 奢華法國貴腐甜酒，受貴腐菌感染的葡萄釀造，蜂蜜、杏桃與番紅花的濃郁複雜度。

name: Port (Tawny 20 Year)
finish: Very long, nutty-caramel, elegant oxidative warmth
productionMethod: Fortified with grape spirit, aged 20 years in small oak casks with oxidative aging
aging: Average 20 years in small oak casks
description: Elegant 20-year tawny port with extraordinary nutty-caramel complexity from two decades of oxidative aging.
descriptionZh: 優雅的20年茶色波特酒，經二十年氧化陳年帶來非凡的堅果焦糖複雜度。

name: Sherry (Fino)
finish: Dry, crisp, almond-saline with pleasant bitterness
productionMethod: Palomino grape, biological aging under flor yeast in solera system
description: Bone-dry fino sherry aged under flor yeast, with nutty, saline character. One of the world's great aperitif wines.
descriptionZh: 在酵母膜下陳年的極乾菲諾雪莉，堅果與鹹味特色，世界最偉大的餐前酒之一。

name: Sherry (Oloroso)
finish: Long, dry, nutty-oxidative with savoury depth
productionMethod: Palomino grape, oxidative aging without flor in solera system
description: Rich oxidative sherry aged without flor, with walnut, toffee, and leather complexity. Great in cocktails.
descriptionZh: 無酵母膜氧化陳年的豐厚雪莉酒，核桃、太妃糖與皮革複雜度，調酒表現出色。

name: Madeira (Malmsey)
finish: Very long, caramelized, smoky-sweet with electric acidity
productionMethod: Malvasia grape, fortified, heated estufagem process or canteiro aging, oxidative maturation
description: Sweet Madeira from Malvasia grape with burnt caramel, coffee, and remarkable acidity. Nearly indestructible wine.
descriptionZh: 馬爾瓦西亞品種釀造的甜型馬德拉，焦糖、咖啡與驚人酸度，幾乎不朽的酒。

name: Moscato d'Asti
nameZh: 阿斯蒂蜜思嘉微氣泡酒
finish: Short, sweet, refreshing with floral fade
productionMethod: Muscat Blanc à Petits Grains, partial fermentation in sealed tanks (Asti method), low alcohol
description: Gently sparkling Italian sweet wine with peach, orange blossom, and honey. Low alcohol and irresistibly refreshing.
descriptionZh: 輕柔氣泡的義大利甜酒，蜜桃、橙花與蜂蜜，低酒精度，清爽迷人。

name: Lillet Blanc
productionMethod: Blend of Bordeaux wines with citrus liqueurs and quinine, aged in oak
description: Elegant French aperitif wine with citrus, floral, and honeyed character. Key ingredient in the Vesper Martini.
descriptionZh: 優雅的法國開胃酒，柑橘、花香與蜂蜜風味，Vesper Martini的關鍵材料。

name: Cocchi Americano
productionMethod: Moscato d'Asti wine base aromatized with herbs, spices, and cinchona bark
description: Italian aperitif wine similar to the original Kina Lillet. Essential for historically accurate Vesper Martinis.
descriptionZh: 義大利開胃酒，近似原始的奎納力麗，歷史正統Vesper Martini的必備材料。

name: Punt e Mes
productionMethod: Aromatized wine with high proportion of bitter components, created at Carpano in 1870
description: Intensely bitter Italian vermouth, halfway between sweet vermouth and amaro. A Negroni upgrade.
descriptionZh: 極度苦味的義大利香艾酒，介於甜香艾和苦酒之間，Negroni的升級之選。

name: Dolin Dry Vermouth
productionMethod: Alpine white wine base aromatized with local herbs and botanicals from the Chartreuse mountains
description: Classic French dry vermouth from Chambéry with delicate herbal-floral character. A bartender favorite for Martinis.
descriptionZh: 來自尚貝里的經典法國乾型香艾酒，細膩草本花香，調酒師製作Martini的首選。

name: Coconut Water
description: Natural coconut water with light sweetness and mineral character. A refreshing, low-calorie tropical mixer.
descriptionZh: 天然椰子水，輕甜帶礦物質，清爽低卡的熱帶調酒素材。

name: Fresh Cucumber
description: Fresh cucumber for muddling or garnish. Adds cool, refreshing character to gin-based cocktails.
descriptionZh: 新鮮小黃瓜，用於搗碎或裝飾，為琴酒調酒增添清涼爽口風味。

name: Fresh Basil
description: Fresh basil leaves for muddling. Adds aromatic herbal complexity to gin and strawberry cocktails.
descriptionZh: 新鮮羅勒葉，用於搗碎，為琴酒和草莓調酒增添芳香草本層次。

name: Espresso
finish: Bold, lingering coffee bitterness with crema sweetness
description: Freshly pulled espresso shot. Essential for Espresso Martini and Irish Coffee.
descriptionZh: 新鮮萃取的義式濃縮咖啡，Espresso Martini和愛爾蘭咖啡的必備材料。

name: Cream of Coconut (Coco López)
productionMethod: Sweetened cream of coconut with added sugar and emulsifiers
description: The original sweetened cream of coconut, essential for authentic Piña Colada. Thicker and sweeter than coconut cream.
descriptionZh: 原創加糖椰奶霜，正宗Piña Colada的必備材料，比椰漿更濃厚甜蜜。

name: Tonic Syrup
productionMethod: Concentrated syrup of cinchona bark, citrus, and botanicals with sugar
description: Concentrated tonic syrup for crafting custom G&T with soda water. More flavor control than bottled tonic.
descriptionZh: 濃縮通寧糖漿，搭配蘇打水自製琴通寧，比瓶裝通寧水更能控制風味。

name: Vanilla Syrup
description: Vanilla bean-infused simple syrup. Adds warm vanilla sweetness to espresso martinis and bourbon cocktails.
descriptionZh: 香草莢浸泡的糖漿，為濃縮咖啡馬丁尼和波本調酒增添溫暖香草甜味。

name: Cinnamon Syrup
description: Cinnamon-infused simple syrup. Adds warm spice to tiki drinks, apple cocktails, and hot toddies.
descriptionZh: 肉桂浸泡的糖漿，為提基飲品、蘋果調酒和熱托迪增添溫暖辛香。

name: Raspberry Syrup
description: Fresh raspberry syrup with vibrant berry flavor. Adds color and fruit sweetness to cocktails and lemonades.
descriptionZh: 新鮮覆盆子糖漿，活力莓果風味，為調酒和檸檬水增添色彩與果甜。

name: Ginger Syrup
description: Fresh ginger-infused syrup with bold spicy warmth. Essential for Penicillin and ginger-forward cocktails.
descriptionZh: 新鮮薑汁糖漿，辛辣溫暖，Penicillin調酒和薑味調酒的必備材料。

name: Passion Fruit Syrup
description: Concentrated passion fruit syrup for tropical cocktails. Key ingredient in Pornstar Martini and tiki drinks.
descriptionZh: 濃縮百香果糖漿，熱帶調酒的關鍵材料，Pornstar Martini和提基飲品的必備。
